A finding is `criterion-anchored` only when the text of the named acceptance criterion, contract clause or fail-stop invariant reaches the cited input; a counterexample the named text does not reach, which falsifies a sentence of the pull-request body, is `reword` whatever feature it concerns (CL-D126).
